resources.name: Pseudopotential generation software (e.g., FHI98PP or oncvpsp)
Initial crystal structures of rutile and anatase from literature

access.notes: Experimental lattice constants and atomic positions from published references: rutile (Abrahams & Bernstein, J. Chem. Phys. 55, 3206 (1971)), anatase (Horn et al., Z. Kristallogr. 136, 273 (1972)). The solver should construct unit cells using space group symmetry and these parameters.
